name: Stat
summary: A big bold number with a small uppercase tracked unit and optional delta. Warp signature primitive. v0.10 — Satoshi-only; tabular alignment via OpenType tnum, not a separate mono face.

value.description: The number. Always render with tabular numerics (Satoshi tnum + lnum) so stacked KPIs align column-true.

unit.description: Small uppercase tracked unit suffix ('%', 'lb', 'days'). v0.10 — Satoshi at .text-data-* with calt off + tnum on.

rules: Trend arrow uses aria-hidden; meaning lives in the delta string.
Real-time Stats are wrapped in aria-live='polite' by the consumer.

do: Always tabular numerics for the value (Satoshi tnum + lnum + zero).
Pair with unit in text-tertiary so the number reads as hero.
Use StatGrid for rows of Stats to enforce uniform sizing.
dont: Don't put delta inside value — separate line.
Don't mix sizes within a row.

changelog.note: Token consumption swapped from font.family.mono to font.family.sans — v0.10 single-typeface system. Tabular alignment now carried by OpenType tnum/lnum/zero on Satoshi.
